(pa)༄༅/ /chos spyod nyams len gyi rim pa rab tu gsal ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru ār+ya ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// chos spyod nyams len gyi rim pa rab tu gsal ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ār+ya ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// spyan ras gzigs la gus btud nas// chos spyod nyams len rim pa ni// gong ma'i gsung las btus te bri// 'dir la stod kyi rtogs ldan chen po shes rab mgon po'i gsung las byung ba chos spyod nyams len gyi rim pa mang du yod pa las/ nyer mkho 'ga' zhig bsdus te bstan pa la/ rang don du bya ba/ gzhan don du bya ba gnyis su yod/ dang po la'ang tshe 'di'i nyams len gyi rim pa/ tshe phyi ma'i nyams len sngon bsu gnyis/ dang po la tho rangs bya ba/ de nas 'phen pa gtong ba/ de nas sdom pa blang ba/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba/ de nas sems bskyed pa/ de nas tshe bsring ba/ de nas bla ma la dngos grub zhu ba/ de nas bskyed rim bsgom pa/ de nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa/ de nas khrus bya ba/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba/ de nas yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba/ de nas sbyin sreg gis tsha ba skol ba/ de nas zas skom longs spyod pa/ de nas bskor ba bya ba/ de nas gtor ma gtong ba/ de nas sāts+tsha gdab pa/ de nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'don pa/ de nas nyams chag bskang ba/ de nas bar chad bsal ba/ de nas srung zlog bya ba/ de nas bya ba thams cad dge sbyor du dril ba ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis su yod/ dang po tho rangs snga bar langs shing gnyid sad ma thag rig pa nam mkhar gtad de/ rlung ro kha yar 'bud/ 'khrul 'khor kha yar bya/ de nas nyams len gang byed kyi khrid rim rnams kyi tshig don la sems cer gyis bltas nas gzhigs 'brel gtong*/ rang lus lha gang mos su lam gyis bsgom/ gnyis pa 'phen pa gtong ba ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom/ cis kyang dgos pa med/ chos nas gsungs pa bzhin mi 'bungs re snyam du go cha gyon no// gsum pa sdom pa blang ba ni/

bshags pa bsdus pa zhig bya/ mchod pa zhig phul nas/ sdom pa rgyas par cho ga bzhin len pa'am/ yang na/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum don dran bzhin pas bya/ bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dkon mchog thams cad bzhugs par bsgoms la/ rang gzhan gyi lus dang longs spyod 'bul/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa'i bsam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes mang du brjod do// lnga pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du ngas sangs rgyas thob par bya/ dge sbyor thams cad kyang de'i ched du bya'o snyam pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur cig nye ring chags sdang med par gyur cig ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// zhes ci rigs brjod do// drug pa tshe sring ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dkon mchog thams cad byon par bsgoms la/ bdag gi dus min 'chi ba zlog tu gsol// tshe'i dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na tshe bum 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ ā yuḥdzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes mang du bgrang*/ tshe dpag med 'od du zhu nas thig le steng dkar po 'og dmar po sran ma phyed bkas tsam gnyis kyi bar na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po hūm̐ mthing ga

de las 'od zer dkar po sna bug g.yas nas thon/ dus gsum sangs rgyas/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga/ tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pa thams cad la phog 'od dmar por zhu/ sna g.yon nas zhugs/ thig le hūm̐ bcas la thim par mos la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag 'phro bcad tsa na/ thig le bdud rtsir zhu/ lus khengs/ 'chi med g.yung drung thob/ bde stong du gyur par bsgom mo// de ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa nā ro pa'i phyag len no// yang na spyi bor a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang du a dkar po las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phros/ bde mchog rigs lnga nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i thugs kar phog thugs ka'i sa bon rnams bdud rtsir zhu/ a la thim zhing thod pa khengs/ lud pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā yur+dzñān sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes mang du bgrang*/ 'phro 'jog tsa na/ rigs lnga thod pa la thim/ thod pa 'od du zhu rang la thim par bsgom/ 'di ni shin tu zab pa rtsa rgyud le'u lnga pa nas gsungs pa'o// yang na/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du tshom bu dgu bkod/ steng du tshe'i bum pa chang dang bum rdzas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba bzhag mchod gtor 'bul/ bum pa tshe dpag med du bskyed/ thugs ka'i sngags las 'od 'phros pas/ tshe'i bcud bsdus par bsgoms la/ oṃ āḥyur de ba sa ra he ka ra re shwa ra he/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa bzlas chang la btab/ tshe dpag med bdud rtsir zhu bar bsgom/ chang rang gis 'thung bdud rtsis lus khengs par bsgom mo// de ni thugs sgrub nag mo nas gsungs pa'o// bdun pa bla ma la dngos grub zhu ba ni/ phyi'i mchod pa rdzas dang yo byad bla ma la 'bul/ nang gi mchod pa lus ngag yid gsum bla ma'i zhabs tog la bkol/ gsang ba'i mchod pa phyag rgya mtshan ldan rgyan gyis spras nas 'bul/ de nas rang yi dam du bsgoms pa'i spyi bor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la/

bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thim par bsgom/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ bla ma las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du phog pas bar chad zhi nas dngos grub thob/ rang las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas sgrib pa dag cing byin rlabs zhugs par gyur/ mos gus kyi gdung ba bskyed nas gsol ba yun ring du gdab/ de nas lag pa thal mo sbyar mos gus bskyed de/ sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i tshul khrims ldan// gsung gi phrin las phun tshogs pa// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus mkhyen// thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pa// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen// mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa// yon tan rgya mtsho khyed la mnga'// sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje// khyed la gus pas dpal du byed// bstan pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur// bsten na 'jigs pa med par byed// bsnyen bkur byas na bde ba thob// de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje// bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod pa bya'o zhes// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// de bas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar// de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du// 'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyis mchod pa dang*// dam chos rtag tu nyen byed cing*// bka' bzhin sgrub pa byed par shog /khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs// 'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang*// me shel med par me mi phyin// de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang*// bla ma med par 'jug mi nus// des na khyod ni mnyes pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma mchog la bdag skyabs mchi// khyed ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i// phrin las de nyid 'grub par mdzod// mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te// rang gi byang chub kyang dor nas// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// khyed kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi// zhes brjod pas/

bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ sku gsung thugs dang lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsgom/ de ltar zhag re la thun bzhi/ drug gnyis/ tha na'ang re re ma chags par byas na tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob bo// 'di ni dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i bzhed pa sa skya pa'i phyag len no// brgyad pa bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rang lus dang snod bcud stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du rang sems hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la khyud cing zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dga' ba 'dzin pa/ sbrang rtsi 'thung ba/ de'i pang du rdo rje phag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang ka pā la 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po'i rgyan can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ skra nag po grol ba/ spyan gsum pa/ sku mdog dmar mos 'khyud par gyur/ yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar snying pos bskor ba las sngags phreng 'phros/ yab kyi sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi pad+ma nas zhugs/ yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du 'khor bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la saṃ ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa bya/ rjes su snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ spyod lam thams cad bskyed rim gyi ngang nas bya/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i sgom bzlas yin/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud nas bshad pa bla ma a bha ya'i phyag len no// gzhan yang yi dam gyi sgom bzlas gang mos byas pas chog go /dgu pa rdzogs rim sgom pa la gtum mo bsgom pa ni/ lus gnad rkang pa tsog pu rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthil gyis g.yon pa'i bol mnan/

lag pa gnyis pus mkhyud bya/ rang lus rdo rje phag mor bsgom/ phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro sde bzhi bsgom/ rang gi lte ba nas me 'bar bas lus kyi nang thams cad khengs/ dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nyug nyug 'dug par bsgom/ oṃ ha ri ni sa badz+ra yo gi nī raṃ raṃ 'ur 'ur 'dus 'dus swā hā/ zhes bzla/ rlung ma bzung na'ang yon tan skye/ rlung kha sbyor bzung na drod rtags myur/ 'khrul 'khor sked pa bskor/ cung zad brdab/ na na gang na sar me'i 'khor lo 'khor bas nad bsregs par bsgom/ de bzhin du rtog pa 'phro na snying gar bskor/ chags pa skye na gsang gnas su bskor/ rjes mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag grib la 'dzem/ zas spyod gzab/ thig le bsrung*/ de ni mkha' 'gro gtum mo rgyud kyi dgongs pa mi tra dzo ki'i phyag len no// de nas phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum dben pa brten/ lus gnad lta stangs bya/ sems ma bcos pa rang bzhin so mar bzhag nyon mongs dang rnam rtog shar na rjes su mi 'brangs/ de'i ngo bor blta/ mi yengs par dran pa rgyun du bsten/ rkyen snang dang chos sku bsre/ lam gyi drod rtags dang nyams snang gang la yang zhums pa dang khengs pa mi byed par chu zla lta bur bsgom/ de yang dang po bla ma nyams myong can gyi drung du sems thag bcad nas yengs med du bsgoms pas je gsal je brtan la 'gro ba yin no// bcu pa khrus bya ba ni/ phyi'i khrus la chu'i khrus ni/ bum nang du chu sna ci mang dang bum rdzas blug bum nang du yi dam gang mos bskyed pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug lha la thim par bsgom/ snying po bgrang*/ lha chur zhu bar bsams nas khrus bya/ yang na rten la sku khrus gsol/ rten gyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi babs par bsams nas khrus bya/ gzhan la yang byas pas chog

sa'i khrus ni/ sa sna tshang ba dang gnas chen gyis/ sin+dhu ra/ ka pā la sogs yi dam du bsgom/ zhu bas lus la byug gtor bya'o// me'i khrus ni/ shug pa ba lu la sogs pa'i me sbar/ ye shes kyi khro bo'i me dpung du bsgom/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par bsam/ me la phar 'gong tshur 'gong bya/ rkang lag me la bshur ro// rlung gi khrus ni/ rlung rnams ye shes kyi rlung lha mo'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ rang gi lus rlung gang che sar phyar/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsam mo// yang*/ nang gi khrus ni/ rang gi lus bum pa/ bum rdzas dang zhi khro'i lha tshogs nang du bzhugs/ rang gi dri chu mi bskyod pa zhu ba'i chur bsgom/ phud dkon mchog la 'bul/ bar nas hub gsum tsam 'thung*/ khrus bya/ lhag ma yi dwags la sbyin no// 'di srung ba thams cad kyi mchog yin no// rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'o// gsang ba'i khrus ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rigs gsum yin/ bcu gcig pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ bla ma'am mdun du sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs pa la/ yid kyi sgo nas dad pa/ ngag gi sgo nas bstod pa/ lus kyi sgo nas yan lag lnga sa la btsugs/ lus mang por sprul/ sems can thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal bar mos nas/ phyag brgya'am stong la sogs par bya'o// bcu gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ mchod pa ci 'grub bshams la/ bla ma yi dam ma lus dang*// dkon mchog gsum dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// bdag dang 'gro ba byin gyis rlobs// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum po la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa yi// phyi nang gsang bas rtag tu mchod par bgyi// thog ma med nas da lta'i dus 'di'i bar// sdig pa mi dge ci bgyis mthol lo bshags// lus can kun gyi dge ba thams cad la// bdag ni dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// bde gshegs rnams la bdag ni gus pa yis// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dang rgyal sras mya ngan 'da' bzhed na// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bzhugs par gsol// de 'dra'i bdag gzhan bsod nams ma lus kun// sems can don du byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes mdor bsdus pa'am gzhan yang*/

ltung bshags bzang spyod la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar bya'o// bcu gsum pa sbyin sreg gis tsha ba bskol ba ni/ rang yi dam du bsgom/ thab ka gzhal yas khang nang du me lha ye shes pa bzhugs par bsgom/ me shing rnams dang gzhan yang bsreg rdzas gang 'dzom la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib rnams bstim/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes ngag tu brjod cing me la bsreg me lha gshegs su gsol/ 'di ni sgrib pa 'dag pa'i thabs zab mo yin no// bcu bzhi pa zas skom longs spyod pa ni/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ zas stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ phud la zhal zas bcos nas/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du zhal zas bdud rtsi 'di// dag cing gtsang mar bshams te 'bul lags na// ye shes thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// oṃ gu ru de ba sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā ḍā ki nī dharma pā la nai wid+yā āḥhūm̐/ zhes dkon mchog la 'bul/ oṃ ha ri te swā hā/ oṃ ha ri te ma hā badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi ha ra ha ra sarba pā paṃ yak+ṣi swā hā/ oṃ a gra piṇ+ḍa a shi bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes changs bu 'phrog ma ma mad dang phud la dbang ba la 'bul/ rang yi dam gyi lto ba'i nang gzhal yas khang du bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad bzhugs pa la/ mchod pa phul bar bsams nas zas za/ lhag ma'i changs bu/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa piṇ+ḍa a shi bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes changs bu/ lhag ma la dbang ba la sbyin no// skom 'thung tsa na/ rang yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas btung ba'i steng du yi ge bam̐ dmar sor gcig tu gyur/ de 'od du zhu/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsam/ phud gtor te/ nyon mongs lnga po rnam dag cing*// ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid// bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin mchog /bla ma yi dam rnams la 'bul// zhes brjod nas 'thung ba'i tshe sngar bzhin du nang gi lha tshogs la mchod par bsam/

de ltar tshogs 'khor byas pas tshogs dpag tu med par rdzogs par gsang ba 'dus pa nas gsungs so// bco lnga pa bskor ba bya ba ni/ bla ma dang rten khyad par can yod na der 'gro/ med na sāts+tsha tsam la yang bskor bas chog bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rten gyi thad du khra phung nge bzhugs par bsgom/ rang gi lus grangs med pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyis bskor bar byed par mos nas/ bstod pa dang gsol 'debs sogs 'don zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+sam+bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+na rat+na bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes brjod de bskor ba gcig bskor na 'bum du 'gyur ro// gzhan yang*/ dpung pa g.yas par bla ma yi dam bzhugs par bsgoms la/ bskor ba byed pa'i 'du shes kyis phyin na yang bskor bar 'gyur ro// bcu drug pa gtor ma gtong ba ni/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma bshams la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ gtor ma'i dri ma sbyangs par gyur/ gang la gang mkho'i 'dod yon gyi phung po nam mkha' khengs pa tsam du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad yi dam du byas te nam mkha' la byon nas gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya sogs/ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bsngo'o// rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig /lan chags bu lon 'khor gyur cig /snang srid mgron rnams thams cad la// tshad med gtor ma 'di bsngos pas// longs spyod ldan zhing tshogs rdzogs nas// thams cad myur du sangs rgyas shog /ces brjod nas gtor ma gtsang sar dor ro// de tsam rtsol bas ma grub na/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi gtor ma ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du bsgom/

sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal shing thog 'bru bcud rtsi sman thams cad gtor mar bsgom/ khams gsum dag pa'i zhing*// srid gsum thugs rje'i mgron// ma lus khyab pa'i zas// chos nyid rtogs pa'i mthus// mi zad gter du bsngo// zhes brjod nas 'bul lo// chu sbyin no// rang thugs rje chen po'i phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yi dwags dang klu la sogs pa sems can dpag med kyis btung bas rang rang gi sdug bsngal las grol bar bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes kha yar bgrangs nas chu la btab/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la sbyin/ yang na/ 'bab chu lta bu la dmigs pa gtad nas byas pas chog 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi// phyag na 'babs pa'i 'o rgyun gyis// yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas nas// khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /ces brjod do// bcu bdun pa sāts+tsha gdab pa ni/ 'jim pa la rin po che dang 'bru sna bsres la/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ oṃ zhes oṃ gcig byung*/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de nas 'bi 'bi chos sku/ sku spar du bcug pa longs sku/ phyir bton pa sprul sku/ lha gang mos su sangs sangs gyur par bsam zhing*/ yi dam gang mos kyi snying po bgrang zhing gdab bo// rab gnas ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ zhes brjod nas me tog gtor/ yang*/ chu me rlung nam mkha' la sku spar bstan te/ oṃ rat+na tset+ya sa na tsar+ya bi bi sa ra ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas gang 'dod pa'i sku krong krong gyur par bsam mo// bco brgyad pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'don pa ni/ rang nyid bstan pa'i gtso bo shākya thub pa'am yi dam gang mos su bsgom/

gsung rab kyi sgra sems can thams cad kyi rna bar thos pas dkar po'i sa bon btab par bsams la/ chos bshad pa'i tshul lam/ yang na/ mdun du sangs rgyas bzhugs pa la chos nyan pa'i tshul lam/ yang na/ chos kyi don rang gi yid la byed cing nyams len gyi tshul te/ de rnams gang mos kyis yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'am/ sher snying la sogs pa'i bka' 'don/ de tsam ma grub na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar a dkar po gcig bsgoms nas klog pa'i tshul gyis a brgya stong bgrang*/ yang na/ rang gi lus dkar po snang la rang bzhin med pa gcig tu bsgom/ sems gsal stong du bzhag la/ dbugs khug gcig la a nyi shu rtsa gcig bgrang*/ 'phro bcad tsam na/ nam mkha'i a rang la thim/ rang lus gsal stong du gyur par bsam/ skye med kyi ngang la cung zad bzhag bsngo ba bya/ dbugs khug gcig la a nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don pa 'di ni bsod nams che/ ltas ngan thams cad zlog dus min 'chi ba la sogs pa mi mthun phyogs thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i man ngag go /bcu dgu pa nyams chags bskang ba ni/ rang tha mal pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bde mchog lhan skyes dkar po yum can gsal gdab/ de las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar dmar spyan drangs/ he ru ka yab yum la thim/ yab kyi zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas bdud rtsi dkar po babs/ yum gyi zhabs g.yon pa'i mthe bong nas bdud rtsi dmar po bab/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas sdig sgrib dag par bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsiṃt+ta shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/

ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du bgrang*/ 'phro 'jog tsa na/ he ru ka rang la bstim/ sems stong nyid kyi ngang la bzhag go /'di ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa kīrti paṇa chen las zhus pa yin no// yang na/ mdun du bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags 'di rnams kyis bskor bar bsgoms la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ a k+ṣo bh+yā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwā nāñtsa swā hā/ zhes mang du brjod/ 'phro bcad tsa na/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag nas mi bskyod par gyur rang la thim/ rang nyid nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin song bar bsgom/ 'di ma chags par byas na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang 'dag lan gcig brjod na rmi lam ngan pa dang bkra mi shes pa rnams 'dag lus la bcangs na dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba zlog ri dwags dang bya dang bu srin sogs 'chi ka ma'i rna lam du brjod na de ngan song du 'gro ba khegs/ tshe 'phos pa rnams la snying rjes sngags 'di lan stong brjod na dmyal bar skyes zin pa rnams kyang myur du thar/ sa'am til lam mar khu'am chu gang rung la bzlas nas gshin po'i rus pa sogs la gtor na ngan song du skyes zin kyang zhag bdun nas mtho ris su thar bar 'gyur ro// 'di ni las kyi sgrib pa sbyong pa'i gzungs nas gsungs pa grub thob nyi ma rdo rje'i thugs dam yin no// nyi shu pa bar chad bsal ba ni/ longs spyod dbul ba'i bar chad byung na/ rang la gang yod la ser sna mi byed par mchod sbyin du gtong*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ mgron rnams bzhi la gtor ma gtong*/ phung po'i tshogs 'khor bya/ 'byor pa dang ldan par gsol ba gdab/ na tsha mang ba'i bar chad byung na/ gang na sar bla ma bsgom/ yang na/ yi ge hūm̐ sngon pos na tsha phar thal tshur thal la gtad pas rjes med du dag par bsgom/

hūm̐ mang du bgrang ngo*// sdug bsngal che ba'i bar chad byung na/ chos thams cad skye med stong par bsgoms nas hūm̐ mang du bgrang ngo*// yang na/ phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad la/ snang srid thams cad hūm̐ me 'bar bas gang*/ log 'dren thams cad bsregs par bsgom/ hūm̐ mang du bgrang ngo*// 'di ni bde ba'i rdo rje la/ ye shes kyi ḍā kis dngos su gnang ba'o// yang na rang nyid phag mor bsgom/ dbyug pa khru gang pa gcig rdo rje me 'bar bar bsgoms nas/ nad dang gdon dang nad pa gsum po thul gyis tshig par bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya/ oṃ yā yā/ 'di ya ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod cing na sar brdung ngo*// nyer gcig pa srung zlog bya ba ni/ bul tog 'bras phye/ lcags kyi sol rdog mu zi/ pha wa dgo dgo/ byin rlabs can gyi bdud rtsi'i thum bu rnams lus la bcangs/ grib dang nad byung dogs pa'i dus su/ oṃ khar+khaṃ dzir+khaṃ bi mā na se u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ des ni grib dang 'goms yams thams cad thub pa khros ma nag mo'i rgyud nas bshad pa'o// gzhan yang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems bh+rūm̐ ser po/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nor bu'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gcig pa lte bar thod pa'i gzhal med khang srubs med pa sgo nga lta bu zhig bsgom/ de'i nang du rang gi lus bh+rūm̐ ser po keng rus kyi rnam pa gcig bsgom/ de'i nang du rang gi sems bde mchog yab yum chung la rdzogs pa zhig bsgom/ ngag tu/ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ zhes mang du bzla/ 'khor lo nam mkha' la si ri ri 'khor bas gnod byed thams cad dum bur gtubs shing phye mar brlag par bsgom/ de rgyun du dran tsam dang*/ srod la nan che bar bsgom/ 'dis ni sngags pa brgya yi rbod gtong yang zlog srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// nyer gnyis pa bya ba thams cad dge sbyor du dril pa ni/

nangs par mal nas langs pa'i dus su/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i mal nas langs par gyur cig ces ngag tu brjod cing yid la bsam/ de bzhin du gos gyon tsa na/ ngo tsha khrel yod kyi gos gyon par gyur cig ska rags 'ching dus/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i ska rags 'ching bar gyur cig sgo 'byed dus/ chos nyid zab mo'i sgo 'byed par 'gyur cig gcod du/ ngan song gi sgo gcod par gyur cig 'gro dus/ byang chub kyi lam du 'gro bar gyur cig rta sogs zhon dus/ brtson 'grus kyi rta mchog zhon par gyur cig chu rgal du/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal bar gyur cig gyen dang skas la 'dzeg pa'i tshe/ thar pa'i lam la 'dzeg par gyur cig 'dod pa'i gnas su slebs pa'i tshe/ myang 'das kyi grong du phyin par gyur cig bla ma dang gang zag bzang po mjal ba'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i bla ma dang mjal nas rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig dkon mchog gi rten dang mjal ba'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam dag tu skye bar gyur cig lam du nyal ba'i dus/ chos kyi lam du nyal bar gyur cig gnyid log pa'i dus su 'od gsal gyi ngang du gnas par gyur cig mchil snabs dang bshang gci sogs 'dor ba'i dus/ bkres pa thams cad tshims par gyur cig gzhan yang spyod lam gang byed kyi sngon dang rjes su blo sbyong dang smon lam gdab bo// gzhan yang thams cad la sdig pa ma byed chos sgor zhugs/ sdom pa srungs/ ma ṇi drongs sogs nyan rung mi nyan rung dge ba la skul na bsod nams chen po thob bo// gnyis pa tshe phyi ma'i nyams len sngon bsu la/ rang gi ro rang gis rdzong gdab pa/ rang gi ro zas rang gis gtad pa/ rang gi ro rang gis bskyal ba/ rang gi ro rang gis bsreg pa/ rang gi bdun tshigs rang gis bya ba/ rang gi shi chos rang gis 'don pa/ rang gi sāts+tsha rang gis 'debs pa dang bdun no// dang po ni/ phung po'i tshogs 'khor bya ste/ rang gi lus che la tsho bar gyur pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/

bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma gtsang rigs kyi mgon po rnams kyis stod nas gsol/ rigs drug lan chags kyi mgron gyis smad nas gsol/ khyag tshad khur bas mnyes shing tshim par bsam mo// gong ma thams cad mnyes gyur cig 'og ma thams cad tshim gyur cig ces brjod/ rjes nas rang gi lus yi dam du krong gis ldang ngo*// 'dis mang du tshogs rdzogs chags sgo zlog go /gnyis pa rang gi ro zas rang gis gtad pa ni/ rang la yod pa dang nye 'khor gyis drangs pa'i zas skom thams cad bdud rtsir bsams la/ nang gi lha tshogs la mchod pa'i tshul du longs spyad do// gsum pa rang gi ro rang gis bskyal ba ni/ rang sems yi dam thugs rje chen po des rang lus bem po 'di khur/ bde chen 'og min gyi dur khrod du skyel/ lus che la tsho ba ri rab tsam du gyur pa/ rig pa yi dam du gsal bas dum bur gtubs shing mgron rnams la bkye/ hab di ri ri gsol bas tshim par gyur/ rjes su rang yi dam du krong gis ldang ngo*// bzhi pa rang gi ro rang gis bsreg pa ni/ rang gi lte ba nas ram̐ las ye shes kyi me 'bar/ rnam smin gyi lus dang dngos 'dzin thams cad thul gyis bsregs/ rjes su rang yi dam du krong gi ldang ngo*// lnga pa rang gi bdun tshigs rang gis bya ba ni/ tshes brgyad dang bco lnga nyi shu gnyis nyi shu dgu gnam stong sogs la mchod pa 'bul/ rigs drug la sbyin gtong sogs rgya chen po bya/ khyad par bdag 'jug len pa ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam gang mos kyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ dad pa dung pa zhig byas nas bla ma rin po che/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ bdag la dbang zab mo bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba nas oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing ga char babs pa ltar byung*/

rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ dbang bzhi thob par bsams nas yi ge gsum mang du bgrang*/ 'di ma chag par bya'o// bla ma shrī pha la'i phyag len no// drug pa rang gi chos rang gis 'don pa ni/ phyi ma la dmigs nas rgyal ba'i bka' rang gis 'don pa'am/ gzhan la 'don du 'jug pa'am/ gzhan gyis 'don pa'i mos pa bya'o// bdun pa rang gi sāts+tsha rang gis 'debs pa ni/ rang gi skra dang sen mo sogs la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ suk+ṣ+me sūk+ṣ+me/ sa me sa me/ shān+te/ dān+te/ a sa mā ro pe/ a na lam bhe/ ta ram+bhe/ ya sho wa ti ma hā te dza/ ni ra ku le/ ni rā wa ṇe/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes pa'i gzungs 'dis rgyu byin gyis brlabs la sāts+tsha gdab bo// gnyis pa gzhan don du bya ba ni/ gzhan la sems bskyed bya ba/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba/ rab gnas bya ba/ gzhan la 'brel ba bzhag pa dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ sems can thams cad la byams pa snyoms pa gcig bsgom/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas su gnas kyang ngo ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje snyam du bsgom/ de nas rang gi sems dang sems can rnams kyi sems dkrug gis bsres la/ stong nyid snying rje'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag rang gzhan thams cad tshe gcig tu grol bar gyur cig ces smon lam gdab bo// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba ri rab kyi rtse mor phyin nas/ thugs ka nas bum pa thogs pa'i lha mo dpag med 'phros/ sems can re re la lha mo re res dbang bskur/ rang gi gnas gsum las 'od 'phros/ sems can rnams la phog pas/ thams cad lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems chos nyid du gyur par bsgom/ sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab/ yang*/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por bsgoms nas/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros bar do'i sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib dag thugs rje chen por lam lam gyur par bsgoms la/

ma ṇi mang du bgrang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing khams su snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar thim par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab bo// gsum pa rab gnas ni/ rang yi dam gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me 'phros/ rten gyi bgegs dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad rten la bstims pas dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ 'khor ba ma stong bar du 'gro ba'i don byed par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab bo// bzhi pa gzhan la 'brel pa bzhag pa ni/ dud 'gro dang skye bo mang po tshogs pa'am re re las mi 'dug kyang rna lam du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs byin rlabs can bsgrag 'og tu 'dzul sa dang mig gis mthong ba'i nye 'khor du sku dang gzungs byin rlabs can 'bri ba'am/ bzhugs su gsol/ chu dang rlung la sogs pa phog pa'i sa thams cad du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs su gsol/ gzhan yang*/ yul gong ma thams cad la mchod pa 'bul/ dman pa thams cad la sbyin par gtong*/ smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab par bya'o// 'di lta bu'i chos spyod kyi rim pa thams cad zhag gcig la grub na rab/ thams cad ma grub kyang gang 'grub la 'bad pa 'don par bya'o// zhes pa 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces pa rje btsun bla ma'i bka' gnang ltar shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog 'bangs kyis tsā ri mtsho dkar du nyer mkhor bsdus pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// zhes pa 'di'ang chos sde 'dir bzhugs bzhed ltar blo gter pas lung spel zhus pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
